strings.zh: 菊子『看到你们这些年轻人{NEWLINE}活力满满地来到这里,{CLEAR}老婆子我很是欣慰啊！{CLEAR}不过对战就是要真刀真枪,{CLEAR}我是不会放水的。{SCROLL}菊子『你选一个战斗规则吧。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Agatha: It does this old woman good to{NEWLINE}see you youngsters come bounding in{CLEAR}here so full of pep!{SCROLL}But a battle is fought for real, and I{NEWLINE}won’t go easy on you.{SCROLL}Agatha: Pick your battle rules.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: League branch: #0–17 are the Elite Four rematch/training lines (Agatha's room). Rocket-occupation branch: #18–43 (Cyrus and Maxie); #18–32 = ‘take turns’ path, #33–37 = ‘both at once’ path.

strings.zh: 菊子『哎呀呀,今天又有空{NEWLINE}来陪我这个老婆子解解闷？{SCROLL}菊子『这次想练单打还是双打？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Agatha: Well, well, got time to keep this{NEWLINE}old woman company again today?{SCROLL}Agatha: Singles or doubles practice this{NEWLINE}time?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 菊子『老了,老了……{NEWLINE}是该把位置让给你们年轻人了。
strings.en: Agatha: I’m getting old, getting old...{NEWLINE}Time I made way for you youngsters.

strings.zh: 全地区的观众{NEWLINE}都会通过我的摄像机看到你的英姿哟！
strings.en: Viewers across the region will see your{NEWLINE}finest moments through my camera!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『赤日、赤焰松！{NEWLINE}不要再做无谓的反抗了,{CLEAR}认罪投降是你们唯一的出路！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Cyrus, Maxie!{SCROLL}Stop resisting. It’s pointless. Confess{NEWLINE}and surrender. It’s your only way out!

strings.zh: 赤日『你好像真觉得自己能打赢我们？
strings.en: Cyrus: You seem to genuinely believe{NEWLINE}you can beat us.

strings.zh: 赤焰松『别把我跟水吾桐相提并论,{NEWLINE}我对固拉多大地之力的掌控{CLEAR}不是那个笨蛋能比的。
strings.en: Maxie: Don’t lump me in with Archie.{SCROLL}My command of Groudon’s power over the{NEWLINE}land is far beyond anything that fool{CLEAR}could manage.

strings.zh: 赤日『我对帕路奇亚空间能力的使用,{NEWLINE}是所有火箭队员中最强的。{CLEAR}今天有我们在这里,{CLEAR}你休想再前进一步。
strings.en: Cyrus: No one in Team Rocket wields{NEWLINE}Palkia’s spatial power like I do.{SCROLL}With us here today, you won’t take one{NEWLINE}more step.

strings.zh: 你的空间能力没什么了不起
strings.en: Your space power is no big deal
strings.notes: menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'Your space power is nothing special'

strings.zh: 只会说大话,你们一起上吧
strings.en: All talk. Come at me together

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你那引以为豪的空间能力,{NEWLINE}在研钵山洞窟、在冠军之路入口、{CLEAR}在石英高原训练场{CLEAR}被我们破解过无数次。{CLEAR}就算你能驱使帕路奇亚,{CLEAR}我也不会输给你！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: That space power you’re so{NEWLINE}proud of...{SCROLL}We broke through it countless times, at{NEWLINE}Mt. Mortar, at the Victory Road{CLEAR}entrance, and at the Indigo Plateau{CLEAR}training grounds.{SCROLL}Even if you control Palkia, I won’t lose{NEWLINE}to you!

strings.zh: 赤日『狂妄的小鬼,{NEWLINE}我要让你付出血的代价！
strings.en: Cyrus: Arrogant brat. I’ll make you pay{NEWLINE}in blood!

strings.zh: 帕路奇亚『Paaa……
strings.en: Palkia: Paaa...

strings.zh: 赤日『帕路奇亚,{NEWLINE}你的力量不是无穷的吗？{CLEAR}怎么会这样……
strings.en: Cyrus: Palkia, isn’t your power{NEWLINE}supposed to be infinite?{SCROLL}How could this happen...

strings.zh: 赤焰松『不要惊慌失措,赤日。{NEWLINE}我和固拉多会让这个冠军明白,{CLEAR}大地之神的力量是凡人无法阻挡的！
strings.en: Maxie: Don’t panic, Cyrus.{SCROLL}Groudon and I will make this Champion{NEWLINE}understand that no mortal can stop the{CLEAR}power of the god of the land!

strings.zh: 固拉多『Grooo……
strings.en: Groudon: Grooo...

strings.zh: 赤焰松『固拉多,怎么连你也……
strings.en: Maxie: Groudon, even you...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你们用洗脑的精灵球{NEWLINE}强行收服传说中的精灵,{CLEAR}它们怎么可能有{CLEAR}帮你们战斗至最后的意志力呢？{CLEAR}所以失败是你们必然的结果。{CLEAR}你们就在接下来的余生中{CLEAR}好好反思自己的罪行吧！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You enslaved Legendary{NEWLINE}Pokémon with brainwashing Poké Balls.{SCROLL}How could they ever have the will to{NEWLINE}fight for you to the very end?{SCROLL}That’s why defeat was inevitable.{SCROLL}Spend the rest of your lives reflecting{NEWLINE}on your crimes!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}大人！我们的英雄！{NEWLINE}打败火箭队咯！好耶！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}! Our hero! Team Rocket’s{NEWLINE}beaten! Yay!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『无论你们用的是空间之力{NEWLINE}还是大地之力,{CLEAR}都只是通过洗脑强行驱使精灵罢了,{CLEAR}像你们这样使出的能力,{CLEAR}就算两个人一起上,也是不堪一击！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Space or land, it makes no{NEWLINE}difference.{SCROLL}You’re just forcing Pokémon to obey{NEWLINE}through brainwashing.{SCROLL}Power used like that falls apart at a{NEWLINE}touch, even with both of you at once!

strings.zh: 赤日『像你这样把跟精灵的感情、羁绊{NEWLINE}当成必修课的小鬼。
strings.en: Cyrus: A brat like you, who treats{NEWLINE}feelings and bonds with Pokémon as{CLEAR}required coursework...

strings.zh: 赤焰松『永远也无法理解{NEWLINE}暴力征服的强大与畅快。
strings.en: Maxie: ...will never understand the{NEWLINE}might and thrill of violent conquest.

strings.zh: 赤日『今天你就用自己的生命。
strings.en: Cyrus: Today you’ll pay with your life...

strings.zh: 赤焰松『为你的天真愚蠢买单吧！
strings.en: Maxie: ...for your naive stupidity!

strings.zh: 赤日『你能打败我只是运气好罢了。{NEWLINE}如果我可以一个人同时掌握{CLEAR}时间、空间、反转的力量,{CLEAR}你一定不是我的对手！
strings.en: Cyrus: You only beat me through luck.{SCROLL}If I alone could command the powers of{NEWLINE}time, space and reversal, you’d be no{CLEAR}match for me!

strings.zh: 赤焰松『或许真的如你所说,{NEWLINE}我没能掌握固拉多的真正力量{CLEAR}所以才会输的这么彻底……
strings.en: Maxie: Perhaps you’re right.{SCROLL}I never mastered Groudon’s true power,{NEWLINE}and that’s why I lost so completely...

strings.zh: 火箭队简直就是噩梦,{NEWLINE}拜托冠军大人快点让噩梦结束吧。
strings.en: Team Rocket is a living nightmare.{SCROLL}Please, Champion, hurry and put an end{NEWLINE}to it.

strings.zh: 这些火箭队押我们过来时{NEWLINE}对我们拳打脚踢的。{CLEAR}实在是太可恶了。
strings.en: When Team Rocket dragged us here, they{NEWLINE}punched and kicked us the whole way.{SCROLL}They’re absolutely vile.

strings.zh: 不论火箭队做这些事出于什么目的,{NEWLINE}都是绝对不可原谅的。
strings.en: Whatever their reasons, what Team{NEWLINE}Rocket has done is unforgivable.

strings.zh: 我刚才还在心中默念{NEWLINE}冠军大人快来救我,{CLEAR}然后您真的就出现了！
strings.en: I was just silently praying for the{NEWLINE}Champion to come save me, and then you{CLEAR}actually showed up!
